question.worked_solution:
The radical $\sqrt[n]{x}$ can be written using a fractional exponent as $x^{1/n}.$

Comparing $\sqrt[n]{x}$ with $\sqrt[3]{4^2},$ we get $x = 4^2$ and $n = 3.$ Therefore,

$$
\sqrt[3]{4^2} = \left(4^2\right)^{1/3}.
$$

Finally, using the power law for exponents, we have

$$
\left(4^2\right)^{1/3} = 4^{2/3}.
$$
